topology_reasoning.observed_structure: Four narrow orthogonal access waveguides enter four lens-like multimode lobes. The lobe tips overlap around the center to form one continuous crossing region. Each visible lobe boundary closely follows an ellipse: the horizontal left lobe runs from about x=590 px to the central overlap, peaks near 110 px transverse width, and the access guide is about 28 px wide.
topology_reasoning.operating_principle: Each single-mode access guide expands adiabatically into a broad, lens-shaped multimode region. Opposing lobes carry the intended straight-through paths, while the fourfold-symmetric central overlap suppresses abrupt discontinuities and reduces scattering/crosstalk at the orthogonal intersection.
topology_reasoning.primitive_decomposition: Union a horizontal and vertical narrow guide spine with four path-extruded elliptical-width lobes. Each lobe is a straight gf.Path whose cross-section width follows an ellipse profile; no device stencil or raw polygon is required.

function_defining_knobs.name: lobe_length

function_defining_knobs.name: center_overlap
function_defining_knobs.role: overlap of opposing lobe tips at the crossing center

function_defining_knobs.name: port_straight_length
function_defining_knobs.role: narrow straight length outside each lobe

iterations.diff_observation: Residuals are thin edge traces: mostly red along the smooth lobe boundaries and narrow access-guide edges, with small blue wedges at the outer lobe tips. No topology-scale missing or extra region is present.
